🔄 Content Updated (Published: October 26, 2026 / Previously listed: March 27, 2026)
Main change: Event date has been rescheduled from May 19 and 30 to December 15.

Hanno Walking Club is holding "Sugoshi Relaxed Walk December."

Date & Time: December 15, 2026 (Tuesday) – Gather at 10:00 a.m.
Gathering Place: West parking lot of Hanno City Hall

Course: Depending on weather and number of participants, you will walk one of the following:

(1) City Hall → Benzaiten → Chikkanji → Nakayama West Signal → Yatsuda → Nionji → Central Park → Hongo Water Purification Plant → Hanno Riverbed Stepping Stones Bridge → Hanno Station → Higashi-Hanno Station → City Hall (approximately 7 kilometers, approximately 2 hours 30 minutes)

(2) City Hall → Around Hanno City (Shimokaji, Futayanagi, Kaji, etc.) → Around Iruma City (Shinko, Noda, etc.) → Busshi Station (return by train) (approximately 7 kilometers, approximately 2 hours 30 minutes)

Cost: Free (insurance is your own responsibility)

What to Bring: Drinks, rain gear, IC transit card, Sugoshi Handbook (if you have one)

Registration: No advance registration – just show up at the gathering place by the start time.

Cancellation Notice: To check if the walk is cancelled due to weather or other reasons, check the Hanno Walking Club website or call Onda at 090-2205-8073 after 3:00 p.m. on the day before the event.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/13340.html
